title: Kings of Judah and Israel

questions.question: Who reigned after Rehoboam in Judah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:1 (ESV): "Now in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam... Abijam began to reign over Judah."

questions.question: Who succeeded Abijam as king of Judah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:8 (ESV): "And Abijam slept with his fathers... And Asa his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: Was Asa a good or bad king?
options: Good, he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord
Bad, he walked in the sins of his father
questions.correctAnswer: Good, he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:11 (ESV): "And Asa did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, as David his father had done."

questions.question: What did Asa remove from the land?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:12 (ESV): "He put away the male cult prostitutes out of the land and removed all the idols..."

questions.question: Who killed Nadab son of Jeroboam and took over Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:27-28 (ESV): "Baasha... struck him down... and reigned in his place."

questions.question: Why did Asa depose his grandmother Maacah?
options: She had made an abominable image for Asherah
questions.correctAnswer: She had made an abominable image for Asherah
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:13 (ESV): "He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen mother because she had made an abominable image for Asherah."

questions.question: With whom was there war all of Asa's days?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:16 (ESV): "And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days."

questions.question: Who did Asa hire to help him against Baasha?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:18 (ESV): "Then Asa took all the silver and the gold... and sent them to Ben-hadad... king of Syria..."

questions.question: What diseased part of his body did Asa suffer from in his old age?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:23 (ESV): "...But in his old age he was diseased in his feet."

questions.question: What prophecy was fulfilled when Baasha killed the house of Jeroboam?
options: The word of the Lord spoken by Ahijah
questions.correctAnswer: The word of the Lord spoken by Ahijah
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:29 (ESV): "...according to the word of the LORD that he spoke by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite,"

questions.question: How long did Abijam reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:2 (ESV): "Three years he reigned in Jerusalem..."

questions.question: How long did Asa reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:10 (ESV): "Forty-one years he reigned in Jerusalem..."

questions.question: How long did Nadab reign over Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:25 (ESV): "Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign... and he reigned over Israel two years."

questions.question: Where was Nadab when he was killed?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:27 (ESV): "...and Baasha struck him down at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines..."

questions.question: What cities did Asa build with the stones of Ramah?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 15:22 (ESV): "...With them King Asa built Geba of Benjamin and Mizpah."

key_verse_text: And Asa did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, as David his father had done. (ESV)
